Student / Exam Memory

Recall Rush: Visual Memory Playbook

Illustrated PDF Playbook + Interactive Companion App • Audience: Students, med school applicants, certification candidates, and lifelong learners preparing for high-stakes exams

MODULE 1 Page 1 of 3 • Recall Rush: Visual Memory Playbook

Page 1: Visual Encoding System

  • ✓ Step 1: Convert each hard fact into one vivid icon or mini-scene
  • ✓ Step 2: Build a 10-stop memory palace walkthrough for each chapter
  • ✓ Step 3: Sketch three bold diagrams per topic using color anchors
💡 Pro Action Tip: Make images weird, oversized, or funny; brains remember absurdity far longer than plain text.
MODULE 2 Page 2 of 3 • Recall Rush: Visual Memory Playbook

Page 2: Active Recall Drill Loop

  • ✓ Step 1: Cover the answer, say it aloud, then flip to check
  • ✓ Step 2: Schedule spaced reviews at 1, 3, and 7 days
  • ✓ Step 3: Flag missed cards into a retry deck for tomorrow
💡 Pro Action Tip: Always test yourself before rereading notes; effortful retrieval builds stronger memory than passive review.
CHEAT SHEET & WORKSHEET Page 3 of 3 • Recall Rush: Visual Memory Playbook

Page 3: Cheat Sheet & Worksheet

  • ✓ Step 1: Run the weekly 20-minute mixed-topic review checklist
  • ✓ Step 2: Log daily streak, cards mastered, and recall accuracy
  • ✓ Step 3: Print the tear-out scorecard and pin it to your desk
💡 Pro Action Tip: Review your toughest cards right before sleep; overnight consolidation locks recall in place.
